description: Auxiliary and exhaust fan endpoints preserve phase order, deposition and material while each speed varies independently from 0% to 100%.

mutants.description: Clamp the 100% auxiliary fan endpoint to 99%; the endpoint row must observe P2 PWM 255 during every positive-XY deposition move.
mutants.test_filter: Auxiliary and exhaust fan speed endpoints reach physical fan commands during deposition

mutants.description: Clamp the 100% during-print exhaust endpoint to 99%; the first P3 command must preserve PWM 255 before deposition.
mutants.test_filter: Auxiliary and exhaust fan speed endpoints reach physical fan commands during deposition

mutants.description: Clamp the 100% completion exhaust endpoint to 99%; the final P3 command must preserve PWM 255 after the last deposition move.
mutants.test_filter: Auxiliary and exhaust fan speed endpoints reach physical fan commands during deposition
